title: A long log waits caught on the rock spur: two tugs free it, and it lands 3 timber
about: Summer 24, 10:00, coming down the west bank from the north with the hook: one long log drifts down the middle lane onto the first rock spur (19,26) and waits there, caught (tilted, a foam crest, a ripple). Hook it from the bank (a little past the rope's length: it lies still); a long log needs two tugs; it pops your way round the spur, then tow it to the slip: +3 Timber.
